Done! I've fixed W-2041. The issue was in the `format_invoice` function which was using integer division (`//`) to convert cents to dollars, dropping the fractional cents. 

The fix extracts dollars and cents separately and formats them with proper padding, so an invoice of 15050 cents now correctly displays as "$150.50" instead of "$150".

All tests pass and the CI build succeeds.
